title: Bias in the Picture: Benchmarking VLMs with Social-Cue News Images and LLM-as-Judge Assessment
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking demographic biases such as age, gender, race, occupation, and sports in Vision-Language Models. Although the bias evaluation rubric used by the LLM-as-judge includes 'religion' as a criterion, the benchmark itself does not specifically target religious or ethical/moral frameworks as core categories of its analysis.
